propositions: sign-review deterministically aborts with store-read-failure when untracked files exist in the shared tracker, blocking plan claims and gates despite a passing review
generation.collect() calls in resign.py:146 and three sibling sites omit ignore_untracked=True, defaulting to strict git status checks that include untracked files in the porcelain output

the fix tolerates unrelated untracked tracker files by passing ignore_untracked=True to collect_plan_relation_snapshot() and generation.collect(), matching the already-fixed contract from bug d7cb-22ae
orchestrator.py:650 swallows the exception silently, causing untracked files to force expensive full LLM re-reviews instead of cheap drift-refresh probes
tracked-dirty state must continue to fail after the fix to preserve the real guarantee that dirty committed state blocks signing
machine-wide signing contention occurs because .tickets-tracker is symlinked into every concurrent session, making one writer's transient temp files block all other sessions' sign operations
